high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from the website entrackr.com, dated March 22, 2024. The headline reads: "Update: Subko Coffee raises Rs 85 Cr led by NKSquared." The author of the article is Kunal Manchanada. The main content of the article states that SubKo Coffee has raised Rs 85.10 crores (approximately $10 million) in a Series B funding round. Notable existing investors who subscribed via rights issue include Pallavi and Srinivas Dempo, Jay Mehta, Gauri Khan Family Trust
